method: Independent unchanged-block reconstruction from saved minimal old/new segments; compare actual source line bytes as metadata, independently map every citation and rebuild every native read-credit set. No application source semantic reread or new read credit is claimed by this verifier.

static_review.point_and_range_math: The independent span model reproduces all preview endpoints; zero-old changes add offset only after their old anchor and are reviewed only when a range crosses that anchor.
static_review.read_credit: Unchanged transfer excludes all replaced old lines and compares source payload bytes and terminators. Separately reviewed active changed lines are added, then all mapped redaction and unverified lines are removed.
static_review.historical_fields: First-pass report_excerpt/claim/report_refs are explicitly preserved; no mapped preview citation appears inside protected provenance/read fields. Historical TS baseline hashes and original native read_sources remain separate from active file identities.
static_review.source_only: The reviewed tool only reads source/Git identity and changes audit files in the active audit copy; preview writes only its audit preview artifact.
static_review.freshness_guard: The final apply guard binds document inputs, tool/source/hunk/review hashes, roots/heads, source identities, planned before/after hashes, summary, citations and canonical remap to the independently reviewed preview. Mode and capture timestamp are intentionally excluded.
static_review.active_alias_fix: The final tool validates rust-active references against active presence, file hash and range bounds and normalizes the label without shifting coordinates. They do not add canonical read credit.
static_review.historical_indexes: Retained rust_non_crates and legacy_only_records are explicitly identified as historical coordinate indexes; current read credit is in files and historical read_sources are preserved.
